name: OutOfAfrica_3G09
source: Gutenkunst et al. 2009 PLoS Genet (three-population out-of-Africa), as tabulated in stdpopsim OutOfAfrica_3G09; Gravel et al. 2011 PNAS refined the same structure. Values are the published diploid Ne, times in generations before present, and per-generation per-lineage migration rates. Forward-time epoch durations below are the differences between the published split times (T_AF=8800, T_B=5600, T_EU_AS=848 generations ago) plus a short ancestral burn-in.
